Title: Topics fail to load from Supabase
Description: TopicsProvider returns empty list despite data existing in DB
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open app 2. Navigate to Explore 3. Observe topic grid
Actual Result: Topics grid shows loading or empty state

Title: Learning objects fail to load
Description: Concept screen shows no content for a concept with known data
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Navigate to a concept 2. Wait for content to load
Actual Result: No content available yet message shown

Title: Google OAuth redirect fails on Android
Description: Google Sign-In does not complete after selecting account
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Tap Sign in with Google 2. Select account
Expected Result: User should be authenticated and redirected to onboarding
Actual Result: Auth flow hangs or returns error

Title: Empty state text truncates on small screens
Description: Start learning to build your library text wraps poorly on 360dp width devices
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open Library with no saved objects 2. Observe text
Expected Result: Text should be fully visible and centered
Actual Result: Text is truncated or overflow rendered

Title: Profile screen overflow on 600px height devices
Description: Profile switch screen Column overflows on small viewports
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open profile switch on 600px height device 2. Scroll
Actual Result: Bottom of screen clipped causing layout overflow

Title: Streak data not displayed on Home screen
Description: Home screen shows mock streak instead of live profile streak data
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open Home screen 2. Check streak section
Expected Result: Real streak from DB should display

Title: Quiz answer validation has single question limit
Description: Quiz widget only handles first question - no pagination through multiple questions
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open concept with quiz 2. Answer question 1 3. Check for Q2
Expected Result: Multiple questions should be answerable in sequence

Title: Onboarding page indicator animation lags
Description: Page indicator dot animation stutters on slow devices
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open onboarding 2. Swipe through pages 3. Observe dots
Actual Result: Animation visible stutter on low-end devices

Title: Search field has no action handler
Description: Search field is decorative - no search functionality implemented
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open Explore 2. Type in search 3. Press enter

Title: Difficulty chip text case inconsistent
Description: 'Beginner' vs 'beginner' display varies between list and detail views
Actual Result: List shows lowercase detail shows title case
